children: BlockBeats reported on September 5 that, according to Arkham monitoring, market maker Wintermute is continuing to buy PONS tokens through a TWAP, or time-weighted average price, strategy. Its current holdings are now worth more than $3 million.
According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, Arkham said Wintermute may soon provide market-making services for PONS on-chain.

title: Wintermute Uses TWAP Strategy to Accumulate PONS Tokens, Arkham Says
